english.title: Possess salmon/trout/instrument/explosive/poison for salmon fishing in Tweed district without right or permission
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) obtained possession of

(A)_[salmon]_
(B)_[trout]_
(C)_[an instrument, namely **(..SPECIFY INSTRUMENT..),]_
(D)_[explosives, namely **(..SPECIFY EXPLOSIVES..),]_
(E)_[a poison or other noxious substance, namely **(..SPECIFY POISON OR SUBSTANCE..),]_

(F)_[as the result]_
(G)_[for the purpose]_

of

(H)_[fishing for or taking]_
(I)_[attempting to fish for or take]_
(J)_[doing an act preparatory to fishing or taking]_

salmon in waters in the Tweed district at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) without legal right, or written permission from a person having such right
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 27 and 30 of the Scotland Act 1998 (River Tweed) Order 2006.
